correctness.rationale: The four representatives agree with the classification and the supplied switches. The independent replay constructs them by diagonal sign conjugation of the Seidel matrix and checks degrees and common-neighbor counts. A support's label traces partition the centers. A queried vertex extends a shattered support exactly when it splits every current trace cell into two nonempty parts. Since shattering is hereditary, this recursion is exhaustive through size four. For closed neighborhoods the replay uses open neighborhoods of the complement, which complement every trace without changing shattering. All eight coefficient rows and maximal open-triple counts match. There are only 28 center concepts, fewer than the 32 distinct traces needed at size five, so the eight polynomials are complete. Subtracting the triple-shadow of all shattered quadruples gives 0,1328,1624,1786 maximal triples, and the independent check that every pair extends excludes smaller facets. All four rows have shattered quadruples, so both dimensions are exactly four and the claimed purity split follows.
residual_risks: RESULT.md line 45 overstates what both supplied scripts check: the matrix script checks pair extension, whereas the bitset script checks pair counts and the quadruple shadow but does not assert pair extension. The matrix check and the independent replay both verify the fact; the purity verdict is unchanged. The enumeration is for this four-graph class only.

evidence: The Johnson paper bounds and characterizes the VC-dimension for Johnson graphs. Brouwer–Van Maldeghem identify the four classes and the precise switching sets. The general graph VC-dimension text defines the closed convention.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A dimension bound or exact dimension determines only the largest degree, not the coefficients or inclusion-maximal supports. The exhaustive graph-class theorem fixes the inputs but not the trace census.

evidence: The neighborhood homology and first-order rank-four records already distinguish the graphs, but report Betti numbers and truth vectors respectively. The VC-dimension theorem is only for Johnson graphs and has no profile data.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Prior separation already rules out novelty of the generic conclusion 'the graphs are distinguishable'. It does not supply the full profile or the open purity classification for these invariants. Actual enumeration of all traces and their inclusion-maximal supports is needed.

evidence: T(8)=J(8,2); the Chang representatives are switches, not Johnson graphs. A Lovász neighborhood face requires a common adjacent center, whereas a shattered support requires a center for every trace, including the full support. The matching switch has 2960 Lovász triangular faces versus 2936 shattered triples. The closed formulation is equivalent to the open formulation on the complement by complementing all traces.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The matching graph and parameter set do not make the complexes equivalent. The complement reduction moves to a different graph family, and dimension computations count neither the individual supports nor their facets.

originality.rationale: The exact T(8) polynomial rows and other distinguishing invariants are prior coverage, and are not credited here. The supported contribution is the complete open and closed coefficient vectors of the three switched Chang graphs and the resulting distinction in open shattered-support facets. The best same-family prior enumeration is of common-neighbor faces, not all traces; the actual counts differ. The inspected classification and VC-dimension sources do not give the new rows or maximal triples.
residual_risks: Additional primary literature queries were deferred and supply no negative evidence. An unindexed exact switched-graph computation may exist; the decision rests on the inspected literature and indexed match comparisons. No novelty is claimed for the triangular rows or for distinguishing these four graphs by any invariant.

value.rationale: The natural open and closed support complexes measure neighborhood trace diversity beyond the common VC dimension and common strongly regular parameters. The census gives reusable exact data for all four graphs, separates the three cospectral Chang graphs under both conventions, and identifies a structural distinction: the open triangular complex is pure while every Chang open complex has both triple and quadruple facets. This is meaningful independently of earlier distinctions by different invariants.
residual_risks: This is a finite exact classification, not a formula for arbitrary strongly regular graphs or a theorem about the shattering effect of general Seidel switching.
